'''Sam Brunk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was the husband of [[Dama Whitesun Brunk]].

==Biography==
Sam Brunk and his wife Dama lived in the town of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. Along with moisture farming, the two also operated a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]]. The two occupations kept both busy to the point that they infrequently visited the [[Lars family/Legends|family]] of Dama's sister, [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru Lars]], who lived twenty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from Anchorhead.<ref name="Life" />

Around [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], the couple got a new [[A-1 Deluxe Floater/Legends|A-1 Deluxe Floater]] [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]. Some time after, the Brunks visited the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]]. There, Sam gave the recent news of [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] being outlawed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the visit, Sam was surprised to find that Beru's husband, [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]], had removed his relatives' headstones from their graves at the homestead.<ref name="Life" />
